name: How can I prepare my home for a major renovation to minimize disruption?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for a major renovation to minimize disruption?

acceptedAnswer.text: To minimize disruption during a major renovation, start by decluttering and packing away valuables from the renovation area. Protect adjacent rooms by sealing doorways with plastic sheeting and covering furniture. Arrange for temporary living arrangements if the project impacts essential areas like the kitchen or bathrooms. Communicate any special needs or concerns with your builder in advance. Creating a clear pathway for workers and materials also helps maintain efficiency and reduces inconvenience for your household.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your home for renovation by decluttering, protecting adjacent areas, arranging temporary living if needed, and communicating special needs with your builder.
